entries.reason: Note for the integrator: the task brief for this batch described 'university-of-georgia-tbilisi' and 'university-of-georgia' as different institutions in different countries, but this audit found the codebase itself (lib/data/mbbs-country-lp.ts GEORGIA_LP_FEATURED_SLUGS and app/seminar-2026 university lists) groups 'university-of-georgia' under the country Georgia alongside other Tbilisi-area universities, and its official site is the same ug.edu.ge domain used for 'university-of-georgia-tbilisi' -- this record appears to be the Umanand-style School of Health Sciences sub-brand of the same Tbilisi institution, not a separate institution in a separate country. A distinct third-party lead-generation site (uog.ge, offering 'Study MBBS in Georgia' with India/UAE phone numbers and a lead-capture form) was found and deliberately excluded as non-official. Please double-check institutional identity/country for this record before publishing.

Second-pass upgrade (2026-07-26): First pass found the header logo rendered only via the site's own <uofg-header> web component with no standalone file. Commons-license technique resolved a standalone, freely-licensed PNG logo, verified HTTP 200..

Second-pass upgrade (2026-07-26): First pass found the header rendered only through custom web components with no 'logo' asset in the page source (the infobox mark used on Wikipedia is a separate non-free enwiki upload).
